League of Legends World Championship Format & Structure
There are several weeks of gruelling, intense competition at the The LoL World Championship, with the tournament beginning with play-ins, where teams from emerging regions and lower seeds from major regions battle for limited spots in the main event. This initial stage already provides you with numerous LoL betting opportunities, especially as teams chase a dream of competing in the main event and performing at above their usual level, naturally resulting in unpredictability. But overall, the initial stage is just a taster for the main event, the League of Legends World Championship.
